# Ceil

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Ceil:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | The number to round up. |

**Returns:** The smallest whole number that is not below `float`.

## Description

Rounds up to the next whole number and returns it as a float.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Ceil(2.1)
Print Ceil(-2.1)
```

```text
3.0
-2.0
```
